headline: Stanley signs 1-year, $1 million contract with Jets
title: Logan Stanley signs 1-year contract with Jets
summary: Logan Stanley signed a one-year, $1 million contract with the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday.
body:
<forge-entity title="Logan Stanley" slug="logan-stanley-8479378" code="player">Logan Stanley</forge-entity> signed a one-year, $1 million contract with the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday.

The 25-year-old defenseman had three points (one goal, two assists) in 19 regular-season games with the Jets last season. He did not have a point in one Stanley Cup Playoff game.

***RELATED: [NHL Free Agent Tracker](https://www.nhl.com/news/free-agency-signings-2023/c-344949384?tid=281072352)***

Selected by Winnipeg with the No. 18 pick in the 2016 NHL Draft, Stanley has 20 points (three goals, 17 assists) in 114 regular-season games, and three points (two goals, one assist) in nine playoff games.
